title: Pesto Pasta Salad
description: Loaded with fresh tomatoes, mozzarella, onion, and sliced basil, all tossed in a vibrant pesto sauce. Can use homemade kale pesto or your favorite store-bought. Top with shredded Parmesan cheese.

steps.instruction: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and let cool.
Chop tomatoes, mozzarella, onion, and slice basil.
In a large bowl, combine cooked pasta, tomatoes, mozzarella, onion, and basil.
Add pesto sauce and toss until everything is well coated.
Top with shredded Parmesan cheese before serving.
